A few starting questions

Does MellowHarness run on the ESP32?

The current runtime runs on a host. Buddygotchi uses a Mac app with an ESP32 display connected over Bluetooth or USB. The ESP32 guide explains the split.

Which parts should I buy for the public build?

Start with the exact CYD board in the parts list, a USB data cable and the public Pixel pack. Check character compatibility before choosing a different board.

Can I try it without a model API key?

Yes. MellowHarness includes ScriptedBrain. The quickstart uses it to exercise rules, decisions and the shared log without hosted inference.

How can I contribute or follow new guides?

Start with the contribution guide, or follow Lab updates on Substack. New guides will be listed here as we document the projects.
